description: Contract for device connection state changes published by the Protocol Service to the message broker

uniqueId.description: Device unique identifier (IMEI, serial number, etc.)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the event occurred

protocol.description: Name of the protocol used by the device

remoteAddress.description: Remote IP address and port of the device connection

lastActivityTime.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last activity from this device

connectionDuration.description: Duration of the connection in seconds (for disconnect events)

idleDuration.description: Duration of idle state in seconds (for idle events)

protocolVersion.description: Version of the protocol used by the device

reason.description: Reason for disconnect or idle state

examples.name: device-connect-event
examples.description: Example of a device connection event

examples.name: device-disconnect-event
examples.description: Example of a device disconnection event

examples.name: device-idle-event
examples.description: Example of a device idle event

validationRules.description: deviceId must be a positive integer
eventType must be one of: connect, disconnect, idle
timestamp must be a valid Unix timestamp in milliseconds
For disconnect events, connectionDuration must be present
For idle events, idleDuration must be present
lastActivityTime must not be after the event timestamp

notes: This contract defines the format of device session events published by the Protocol Service
The events are published to the 'device.sessions' topic in the message broker
Consumers should handle potential duplicate messages due to at-least-once delivery semantics
The deviceId is used as the partition key to ensure ordering of events for the same device
All timestamps are in Unix time (milliseconds since epoch)
